subject: Temporary credit allowance for paused pilot - Helio Labs
messages:
From: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@helio.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helio.ai
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: temporary credit allowance for paused pilot

Hi Irene,

Quick context — we kicked off the Helio MediaPilot with Redwood last month and hit an internal snag: procurement has paused our paid account onboarding pending a vendor-compliance review that will take 3–4 business days. The team has an active workload against the trial sandbox; we risk losing momentum and the evaluation artifacts we've built if the trial credits fully expire this week.

Would Redwood consider a short-term allowance (48–72 hours) or temporary top-up so the trial can remain active while procurement finishes the review? We’re prepared to accept a conditional credit and sign any confirmation email.

Attached: procurement_timeline.pdf (one-page)

Appreciate any help — Rajiv

--
Rajiv Patel
Head of ML Engineering | Helio Labs
rajiv@helio.ai
+1 415-555-0132

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Patel <rajiv@helio.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 05 Dec 2027 12:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: temporary credit allowance for paused pilot

Thanks Rajiv — sorry to hear about the procurement delay. I’ve looped in Ben (AE) and Kimberly (Ops/Commercial) so we can assess credit options quickly.

Ben: can you pull a usage snapshot and estimate the minimum buffer (tokens/credits) Helio needs to keep the sandbox alive for the next 72 hours? If we can keep this to a concise one-off allowance and track it against HL-2027-009, I’ll push for an expedited approval.

Kimberly: if we approve a short, conditional allowance, I’ll note that it’s contingent on Helio confirming procurement email and signing the one-line acceptance in reply. Any objections to a 72-hour conditional top-up?

Irene

--
Irene Choi
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
415-555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv@helio.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 08:45:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary credit allowance for paused pilot

Thanks — pulled the numbers and attached a short CSV (usage_snapshot.csv). Summary: Helio consumed ~62% of their sandbox credits over the last 18 days, projected daily consumption at current test cadence is ~7.5% of the trial pool. To avoid data loss / KV expiry for active evals I recommend a 72-hour buffer equivalent to ~25% of their original trial allotment (we can granularize to token units if needed).

Proposed plan:
- Grant a conditional 25% trial credit allowance tied to deal HL-2027-009 for 72 hours (auto-revoke after window)
- Require Helio to reply with procurement contact + expected completion date (to attach to the ticket)
- If procurement completes within 72 hours, we roll them into the paid onboarding and reverse any temporary flags; otherwise, we close the capability and log the expired tokens.

If approved, I’ll create a billing note and attach the temporary credit record so CS & Sales have visibility.

Attachments: usage_snapshot.csv

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
+1 650-555-0114

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv@helio.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2027 17:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary credit allowance for paused pilot

Irene/Ben — OK to proceed with the conditional 72-hour allowance at 25% of the original trial pool. Conditions:
1) Helio must reply to this thread confirming procurement point-of-contact and expected completion date.
2) The credit is strictly a one-time emergency buffer and will be auto-revoked after 72 hours.
3) Finance will record the adjustment against HL-2027-009; this does not set a precedent without Ops sign-off.

Ben: please apply the temporary credit and add the billing note. Rajiv: once you confirm procurement, we’ll flip the switch.

Kimberly
